---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for MOSE
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
Explain what problem this feature would solve or what use case it addresses.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative approaches? Describe them here.

## Benefits
Who would benefit from this feature and how?

## Implementation Complexity
If you have technical knowledge, estimate the complexity:
- [ ] Simple (minor changes)
- [ ] Medium (moderate changes)
- [ ] Complex (major changes or new dependencies)

## Related Features
Are there existing features that this would build upon or interact with?

## Examples
If applicable, provide examples from other software that implements similar features.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Willingness to Contribute
- [ ] I'm willing to work on implementing this feature
- [ ] I can help test this feature once implemented
- [ ] I can only suggest and provide feedback
